purpose: Fail-safe route refinement for Octave Tempo Operations Management: reuse only the existing vendor-thin connector scaffold that current/legacy vendor material supports, without claiming a REST/OData/database contract or raising evidence above discovery-queued.

patch.evidenceNote: Current vendor pages identify Octave Tempo Operations Management as the product formerly known as j5 Operations Management. The platform covers operations management, shift execution, procedures, safety/compliance, maintenance coordination and contextual operational data. Legacy Hexagon j5 product URLs now redirect to the Octave domain, while vendor material documents j5/Tempo-style connectors to operational systems. WFM therefore reuses only the generic vendor-thin connector scaffold at discovery stage; this is not evidence of a stable outward REST/OData/database interface. No authentication, pagination, rate-limit or supported outward object contract has been verified for a WFM client. The cross-host product migration is documentation/identity evidence only and does not permit customer-data requests to follow redirects automatically.
